title: SNUBA Tours of Kauai
specs: Never more than 20 feet from surface raft
Explore Hawaiian reefs with abundant marine life
No certification or previous experience required
blurb: Guests experience SNUBA, a shallow water diving system that allows breathing underwater without certification. Tours are guided by a Snuba Program Coordinator who familiarizes guests with the equipment and leads a guided underwater tour. The dive is never more than 20 feet from the surface raft, exploring Hawaiian reefs with abundant marine life.
